headline: [Vietnam Stock Market] Lack of Momentum, Mixed Trading; Vingroup Shares Weaken Under Foreign Selling Pressure
summary: Vietnam's stock market traded mixed on the 30th, diverging from Asian peers that rose on easing oil prices and Fed remarks ruling out an October rate hike. Vingroup shares weakened under foreign selling pressure.
why: The Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange lists large conglomerates such as Vingroup, whose shares heavily influence the VN-Index. Foreign flows are a key driver of Vietnamese equity sentiment.
